implementation_spec.cadence: One email a week, Tuesday 09:00 UTC (10:00 UK in BST, 09:00 UK in GMT)
implementation_spec.consent_named_content: weekly UK broadband deal roundups and occasional switching guides

agents.name: Planner
agents.job: Fix the week key, subject and preheader. Pull live providers, newest guides and GEO hubs. Do not invent prices.

agents.name: Editor
agents.job: Keep the issue short: one lede, five from-prices, three guides, four area links, tools. British English. No fake social proof.

agents.name: Compliance
agents.job: Confirmed subscribers only. Named sender. Affiliate disclosure. Unsubscribe in body and List-Unsubscribe header. No personal Gmail. No pre-ticked anything.

agents.name: Sender
agents.job: Preview the live HTML. Test one address. Then send the same issue to the confirmed list via domain SMTP.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.job: Track newsletter_signup on confirm, outbound_provider_click from the web twin, and do not treat opens as a PECR basis.

issue_stack: Preheader: Check from-prices at your address. Unsubscribe any time.
Lede: this is a roundup, not a national cheapest promise
Five provider from-prices with verified date and Check deals CTA
Four area hubs (London, Manchester, Birmingham, Glasgow)
Tools: speed test, Broadband Match, cost calculator
How we make money + unsubscribe + contact page
seo_geo: The email is a push copy of a public weekly page so Google and answer engines can cite the same roundup.
Every deal CTA goes to an address checker, never a fake national from-price as the only action.
GEO hubs and updated guides recycle high-intent URLs already on the site.
Month and ISO week in the title keep the page fresh without a new URL every week.
affiliate_rules: Disclose commission in the email and on the web twin.
Rank from live provider data, not from who pays more.
Do not put unnamed partners on the consent tick.
Primary CTA is Check at your postcode, not a dark-pattern countdown.
send_rules: Only status=confirmed, never pending or unsubscribed
Personalise unsubscribe token; do not send a shared unsub link
If domain SMTP is missing, skip the send rather than use Gmail
Vercel Cron fires GET /api/newsletter/send every Tuesday 09:00 UTC with CRON_SECRET
Skip rather than use Gmail if domain SMTP is missing
Skip if this ISO week was already sent (newsletter_sends.week_key)

send_timing.uk_clock: 10:00 in British Summer Time, 09:00 in GMT
send_timing.why_not_monday: UK and platform benchmarks treat Monday as inbox-backlog: weaker than Tue-Thu. Consent says weekly, not Monday.
send_timing.why_not_weekend: Consumer comparison mail is opened at a desk or on a commute, not Saturday.
evidence: MoneySavingExpert Money Tips FAQ (live): after the first week, emails are usually sent on a Wednesday, sometimes Tuesday night or Thursday.
UK agency round-up (Echelon Media): Tuesday is the strongest day; 10:00-11:00 and 14:00-16:00 UK; avoid early Monday and Friday afternoon.
Primo Interactive UK 2026 playbook: newsletter default is Tuesday 10:00 local; Monday is a second choice once Tue/Wed are used.
Campaign Monitor / Mailchimp-style 2026 summaries: Tuesday or Thursday 09:00-11:00 local for opens; weekday gaps are small, list hygiene matters more.
Fintech/consumer money niche heatmaps: Tuesday about 09:00 local.
